headline: Brazil Central Bank Expected to Maintain Selic Rate at 13.75%
summary: Brazil's central bank is expected to hold its benchmark Selic rate at 13.75%. This comes shortly after the domestic stock market dropped significantly in a single session.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions are critical for determining domestic borrowing costs, influencing currency valuations, and shaping fixed-income and equity returns in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: The central bank rate decision directly establishes the benchmark policy rate for Brazil.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
